property_summary: Calling assertionDisputedCallback from a non-optimisticAsserter address reverts in the reference (onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier) but succeeds in the mutant (missing modifier), causing a revert vs. no-revert divergence.
change_summary: Delete the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier from assertionDisputedCallback, so any address can call it and trigger the empty function body.
